texts.zh: 出于某些原因，曾经有人将一个小行星拖拽到了[From.GetName]的轨道上。在小行星表面，还能找到当年使用过的巨大的引擎和制动推进器，虽然它们已经很长时间不能工作了。不管是谁搬运小行星，此人也采掘了小行星的矿物，但是这些设施看上去似乎刚刚启用就被废弃了。
texts.en: For some reason, someone has towed an asteroid into a stable orbit around [From.GetName]. The massive engine sections and braking thrusters can still be found on the surface, although they have long since been rendered inoperable. Whoever did this also mined the asteroid for minerals, but these operations were seemingly abandoned shortly after they begun.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]附近小行星的轨道是如此完美无暇地稳定，也不难理解为什么我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]会认为它是被人工放置在这个地方了。然而，那里也没有任何推进系统或者其他人工航行的迹象。唯一的自然演化结论是，由于某种几乎荒谬到不可能成真的几率，这颗小行星被[From.GetName]的重力场捕获了。我们在这颗小行星的表面还探测到了几种十分稀有的水晶。
texts.en: The asteroid around [From.GetName] has such a perfectly stable orbit that it's easy to understand why our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] thought it was placed there artificially. Yet, there are no conclusive indications of any propulsion systems or any other artificial marring. The only natural conclusion is that, by some absurdly improbable chance, the asteroid got caught in [From.GetName]'s gravity field. We have also detected some rare crystals on the surface of the asteroid.

summary.text:
# 轨道小行星 / Asteroid in Orbit

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:461; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:4577 (anomaly.660); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:3124 (anomaly.6875)

## 如何开始 How it starts

不宜居的普通星球（非卫星）可能生成（1级，权重3）。

Can spawn on a regular uninhabitable planet, not a moon (level 1, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.660“被牵引的小行星”（工程矿藏 d_engineering_3 + towed_asteroid 修正；若所在星球已有战略资源则权重为0）与 anomaly.6875“便利的采矿”（在系统中生成晶体小行星并设置稀有水晶矿藏 d_rare_crystals_2，首次发现时给出战略资源提示）。

anomaly.660 "Towed Asteroid" (d_engineering_3 deposit plus the towed_asteroid modifier; weight 0 if the planet has a strategic resource) and anomaly.6875 "Convenient Mining" (spawns a crystal asteroid in the system with a d_rare_crystals_2 deposit and a first-find strategic-resource message).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个结果互斥（各50%；有战略资源时只会得到 6875）。

The results are exclusive (50% each; with a strategic resource only 6875).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

anomaly.660 的第二个选项仅限岩石类（Lithoid）起源（asteroid_thrusters 修正）。

anomaly.660 has a second option only for the Lithoid origin (asteroid_thrusters modifier).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常与两个事件；编译树正确（p=0.50* 即因战略资源条件而被修改的权重）。

Checked the anomaly and both events; the compiled tree is correct (p=0.50* is the weight modified by the strategic-resource condition).
